1. (Currently amended) A control system comprising: a controller having a processor and memory, wherein the controller is communicatively coupled to automation components in the control system and configured to facilitate performance of a process through interoperation with the automation components, the controller comprising: a model determination module configured to determine a model that describes the process; an input/output variable determination module configured to determine input and output variables of the process; a constraint determination module configured to determine constraints on the input and output variables; an objective function determination module configured to determine an objective function associated with the process; and a holistic state data storage module configured to store the model, the input and output variables, the constraints, and the objective function in one of a plurality of fields in holistic state data in the memory, wherein the holistic state data is communicated to the automation components to enable the automation components to detect and operate with the controller.

2. (Currently amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller is communicatively coupled to the automation components via a communication network and is configured to transmit the holistic state data to each of the automation components upon connecting to the communication network.

3. (Currently amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller is communicatively coupled to the automation components via a backplane and is configured to transmit the holistic state data to the automation components upon connecting to the backplane.

4. (Currently amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the holistic state data is formatted according to a standardized format that is understood by each of the automation components.

5. (Currently amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the holistic state data storage module is further configured to: determine an intermediate search result of an optimization search; determine a state of the optimization search when the intermediate search result is determined; and store the intermediate search result and the state in an optimization state field of the holistic state data.

6. (Currently amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the holistic state data is configured to facilitate performing an optimization search in conjunction with one or more of the automation components in the control system.

7. (Currently amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the holistic state data storage module is further configured to: determine computational capabilities of the controller; determine interconnections with the automation components in the control system; and store the computational capabilities and the interconnections in a controller settings field of the holistic state data.

8. (Currently amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller is configured to transmit the holistic state data to a server in the control system to facilitate determining an optimization problem.

9. (Currently amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises an in-memory database configured to store the holistic state data.

10. (Currently amended) A tangible, non-transitory computer-readable medium configured to store instructions executable by a processor of a controller, wherein the instructions comprise: instructions to receive, using the processor, control system configuration data; instructions to determine, using the processor, automation components communicatively coupled to the controller and characteristics of the automation components based at least in part on the control system configuration data; instructions to determine, using the processor, an optimization problem based at least in part on the automation components and the characteristics of each of the automation components; and instructions to command, using the processor, one or more of the automation components to perform a control action in a process, wherein the control action is determined based at least in part on the optimization problem.

11. (Currently amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 10, wherein the characteristics of each of the automation components comprise a model used by the automation component, and wherein the instructions to determine the optimization problem comprise instructions to determine the optimization problem based at least in part on the model used by each of the automation components.

12. (Currently amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 10, wherein the characteristics of each of the automation components comprise a computing capability of the automation component, and wherein the instructions to determine the optimization problem comprise instructions to determine the optimization problem based at least in part on computing capabilities of each of the automation components.

13. (Currently amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 10, wherein the control system configuration data comprises a plurality of holistic state data structures, wherein each of the plurality of holistic state data structures corresponds with one of the automation components.

14. (Currently amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 13, wherein the instructions to determine the automation components and characteristics of the automation components comprise instructions to parse each of the plurality of holistic state data structures.

15. (Currently amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 13, wherein each of the plurality of holistic state data structures comprises a standardized format with identical fields.

16. (Currently amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 10, wherein the instructions to receive the configuration data comprise instructions to receive the configuration data from a cloud-based server.

17. (Currently amended) A method for performing diagnostics on a control system comprising: capturing, using a processor, holistic state data from a controller in the control system; simulating, using the processor, operation of the controller based at least in part on the holistic state data while the controller performs other operations; analyzing, using the processor, the simulation of the controller to perform diagnostics on the controller; and adjusting, using the processor, operation of the control system based at least in part on the diagnostics.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein: the simulating operation comprises simulating performance of various control actions by the controller; and the analyzing the simulation comprises analyzing results of the various control actions.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein the analyzing the simulation comprises: determining a predicted response to a control action determined by the controller using a model; and comparing the predicted response with an actual response to the control action to determine accuracy of the model.

20. (Currently amended) The method of claim 19, comprising adjusting the model when the predicted response and the actual response vary by a threshold amount.
